text:
maya: Customer acme-payments reported p99 jump ~3x on chat.generate after last night's runtime rollout. They see it reproducible for long-context (>1k tokens). Happening on redwood-13b in us-west. Request id: req_0a1b2c
sam: noted. any kernel_select logs or perf counters? :eyes:
maya: pasted top-level snippets below:
```
kernel_select: model=redwood-13b seq=1536 chosen=flash_attn_v2 compile_flags=O2_SDPA=enabled heuristics_version=4 latency_ms=215 p99=203
kernel_select: fallback=sdpa_quant_v1 reason=heuristic_hysteresis threshold_ms=180
```
elena: that matches the midnight change (rev ea3f9b) where we adjusted hysteresis thresholds. looks like churn between flash and sdpa for long sequences which can spike tail latency if fallback is happening mid-request
tess: can we repro locally? maya, can you paste a minimal curl that reproduces the p99?
maya: sure — stripped example:
```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"<long chat>...","max_tokens":1024}'
```
I repro'ed with their payload and saw p50~120ms, p99~220ms
sam: I rolled a canary flag change to prefer SDPA fallback sooner at 03:12 (attention.hysteresis 0.6 -> 0.4) on canary pool. ops-bot reported flag update.
ops-bot: flag_update: attention.hysteresis -> 0.4 (canary=10%) by sam
sam: early canary metrics: p99 for affected requests dropped ~30%. still validating across other models/seqs
elena: if canary holds we should back out the hysteresis change from main rollout and issue a hotpatch. agree?
maya: customer is on dedicated infra — they want immediate mitigation. can we pin a route that forces SDPA for seq>1024 until we fix?
tess: I'll run a repro matrix tonight across seq=[512,1024,1536] and toggling O2_SDPA on/off, collect traces and perf counters, and upload artifacts to /tmp/attn_repro.tar.gz. owner: tess, ETA ~12h
sam: saving kernel traces to /var/log/runtime/kernel_select/1798884321.log and collecting perf counters. prepping rollback playbook: CLI to change attention.hysteresis and a one-command rollback to previous heuristic. if canary shows sustained improvement for 1h we escalate to full rollback. :thumbsup:
elena: next steps: 1) tess repro and upload artifacts; 2) sam finalize rollback playbook and runbook; 3) if canary steady -> full rollback and patch RCA. assign elena for RCA
sam: assigning mitigation->sam, RCA->elena. I'll also open a follow-up in eng-ml for kernel heuristics RCA and share perf diffs. :eyes:
maya: updated the customer ticket to "investigating - mitigation applied", gave 6h ETA contingent on canary. thanks everyone.
